faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Clear answers about the structure, certification, internship and what is included.

items.question: What is this program?
items.answer: The Performance Marketing Mastery Program is an 8-month course covering paid advertising, SEO, YouTube, email marketing, digital products and AI automation.

items.question: How long is the course?
items.answer: It runs for 8 months, split into 2 semesters of 4 months each, with 3 classes every week.

items.question: What are the two main levels?
items.answer: Level 1 is Paid Marketing. Level 2 is Organic Digital Marketing and Advanced Platforms.

items.question: Which books are covered?
items.answer: Meta Ads AI Mastery, Google Ads Mastery, Digital Marketing Strategy with AI & ChatGPT, Advanced Programmatic Marketing, Organic Digital Marketing & SEO Mastery, YouTube SEO & AI Automation Mastery, Email Marketing Mastery and Complete Etsy Mastery.

items.question: Is this exam and certification based?
items.answer: Yes. The program is exam and project based, with quizzes, assignments, live project evaluations, final exams, practical evaluations and certification requirements.

items.question: Is attendance required?
items.answer: Yes. You need at least 85% attendance to qualify for certification.

items.question: Does the course include an internship?
items.answer: Yes. It includes a 2-month real-world internship.

items.question: Does it include AI automation?
items.answer: Yes. AI automation appears across Meta Ads, ChatGPT strategy sessions, Go HighLevel, SEO automation, Zapier, n8n, AI agents and AI-driven email marketing automation.

items.question: What bonus kit is included?
items.answer: Media planning templates, social media strategy and case study templates, creative and client briefing templates, project sheets, optimization checklists, a priority tracker, notes, books and PPT materials.

items.question: What are the key student outcomes?
items.answer: You should master Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, SEO, email marketing, Etsy and AI automation, while gaining freelancing, agency, entrepreneurial, campaign implementation, mentorship and career readiness skills.
